rules.name: Always use strict types
rules.description: All PHP files must start with declare(strict_types=1);

rules.name: Type hints required
rules.description: All method parameters and return types must have type hints

rules.name: PHPDoc for public methods
rules.description: All public methods must have PHPDoc comments

rules.name: Tests in test directory
rules.description: Test files must be in test/ directory and extend TestCase

rules.name: No API keys in code
rules.description: Never hardcode API keys or secrets
